focus.title: 美国拟对中国成熟制程芯片加征301关税，半导体出口管制范围扩大至EDA工具
focus.summary: 据多家外媒报道，美国贸易代表办公室正在准备对来自中国的成熟制程芯片（28nm及以上）启动新一轮301调查，并可能加征最高25%的关税。同时，BIS拟将部分EDA软件纳入对华出口管制清单，要求许可证方可出口。此举将直接影响中国芯片设计企业获取先进设计工具，建议相关企业提前评估供应链替代方案并做好合规备案。
focus.title_en: US Weighs New Section 301 Tariffs on Chinese Mature-node Chips, EDA Export Restrictions Expanded
focus.summary_en: According to multiple foreign media reports, the USTR is preparing a new Section 301 investigation into Chinese mature-node chips (28nm and above), potentially imposing tariffs up to 25%. Meanwhile, BIS plans to add certain EDA software to the export control list, requiring licenses for shipments to China. This will directly impact Chinese chip designers' access to advanced design tools. Companies are advised to assess supply chain alternatives and ensure compliance readiness.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁庭裁定：中资企业因不可抗力解除镍矿长协获支持，疫情非唯一依据
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中资企业与印尼矿商的镍矿长期供货合同纠纷作出裁决。仲裁庭认为，印尼2024年出口禁令及当地政策剧变构成不可抗力，支持中方企业解除合同且无需承担违约金。该案明确了：不可抗力条款可涵盖政府政策突变，且“商业不可行”标准优于“履行不可能”。为中国出海矿业企业合同设计提供了重要参考。
case.title_en: SIAC Tribunal Upholds Force Majeure Termination of Nickel Ore Long-term Contract by Chinese Company, Citing Government Policy Change
case.summary_en: In a recent ruling, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) upheld a Chinese company's right to terminate a long-term nickel ore supply contract with an Indonesian miner, finding that Indonesia's 2024 export ban and drastic policy shifts constituted force majeure. The tribunal applied a 'commercial impracticability' standard rather than strict impossibility. This case provides key guidance for Chinese overseas mining enterprises in drafting force majeure clauses.

policy.title: 广东省发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动合规指引》，建立数据出境“白名单”机制
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室于7月14日正式发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动合规指引》，明确在“数据安全有序流动”原则下，对医疗、金融、物流等7个行业试点数据出境“白名单”机制。列入白名单的企业，经备案后可免于单独开展数据出境安全评估。该指引将于2026年9月1日起施行，建议相关企业尽快对照白名单条件完成内部数据分类分级与合规整改。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.14
policy.title_en: Guangdong Issues Cross-border Data Flow Guidelines for GBA, Introduces 'Whitelist' Mechanism for Data Exports
policy.summary_en: On July 14, the Guangdong Provincial Cyberspace Administration released the 'Compliance Guidelines for Cross-border Data Flow in the Greater Bay Area', establishing a pilot whitelist mechanism for data exports in seven industries including healthcare, finance, and logistics. Whitelisted enterprises, after filing, will be exempt from separate security assessments. The guidelines take effect on September 1, 2026. Companies are advised to promptly classify data and complete compliance upgrades to qualify for the whitelist.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资审查新规下，中资应避免通过第三国转投美国敏感技术
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期依据第14105号行政令发布了最终规则，扩大对华投资审查范围至半导体、AI、量子计算等领域的“绿地投资”及少数股权收购。实务中，中方通过新加坡、开曼等第三国实体迂回投资亦被纳入审查。建议出海企业：1）在交易结构设计阶段即引入美国律师进行反向CFIUS筛查；2）避免以“被动投资”名义规避审查；3）在合资协议中嵌入合规退出条款。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Under New US Outbound Investment Rules, Chinese Firms Should Avoid Routing Sensitive Tech Investments via Third Countries
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's final rule under Executive Order 14105 expands review of Chinese investments in semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing to include greenfield investments and minority acquisitions. Indirect investments via Singapore, Cayman Islands, etc. are also covered. Practical advice: (1) engage US counsel for reverse CFIUS screening at deal structuring stage; (2) avoid using 'passive investment' labels to circumvent review; (3) include compliance exit clauses in joint venture agreements.
